source: Dukascopy USATECH.IDX/USD BID 1-minute CFD proxy; not CME NQ

instrument_assumptions.identity_limit: NQ-equivalent sizing is illustrative, not source CFD specification.

rules.lookback: highest high / lowest low of 50 fully completed session-anchored 30m bars
rules.entry: native buy STOP and sell STOP, cancel opposite after fill; max 2 entries per Chicago Globex date
rules.exit: market at next 30m boundary open; next actual source minute if boundary print is absent
rules.ambiguous_ohlc: Native engine ledger retained as modeled. Separate conservative bound replaces each affected trade/event with worst-case loss; no intraminute sequence inferred.

trials.name: native_additional_half_spread
trials.note: B plus 0.125 index points per fill; extra one tick round trip, proxy stress.

trials.name: conservative_ambiguous_bound
trials.method: Replace ambiguous executions by -$1000 nominal plus B round-trip commission and slippage. Conservative diagnostic, not native replay.

skill_invariants: ml4t-run-backtest: Strategy/Engine/DataFeed; future-event fills; explicit costs
ml4t-calendar-ops: Chicago session dates and DST-aware UTC boundaries
ml4t-build-bars: only 30 complete source minutes form a decision bar
ml4t-lookahead-bias: levels released only after prior completed bar
ml4t-validate-data: source row, duplicate, null, and OHLC audit
ml4t-cost-model: isolate commission and adverse slippage
